name: Awakened Rat
sourceWitness: Read the printed adventure folio facsimile and the 2014 Monster Manual base stat block. The adventure facsimile’s reader sheet is one greater than its printed folio.
errataEvidence: The publisher errata index does not list a Dragon Heist correction for these entries. The 2014 Monster Manual errata has no changes to the referenced base block.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the reused portrait at beast-ready-batch-02/parts/b02_08/portraits/rat.png.
habitatEvidence: p. 102 places Jeryth’s guide in the Castle Ward sewers. The tags describe that encounter.
printingNotes: p. 102 sets the guide rat’s Intelligence to 10 and says it speaks Common. The remaining statistics come from the 2014 Rat.

name: Diatryma
sourceWitness: Read the printed adventure folio facsimile and the 2014 Monster Manual base stat block. The adventure facsimile’s reader sheet is one greater than its printed folio.
errataEvidence: The publisher errata index does not list a Dragon Heist correction for these entries. The 2014 Monster Manual errata has no changes to the referenced base block.
appearanceEvidence: Original portrait with a broad prehistoric beak, vestigial wings and subdued colored feathers, based on the printed description of a colorful flightless bird.
habitatEvidence: The Feather of Diatryma Summoning on p. 191 identifies the Underdark as the bird’s native range.
printingNotes: The specific item entry changes Beak from slashing to piercing. The creature inherits the other Axe Beak statistics. Allegiance, commands, duration, and language comprehension are the described properties of the summoned bird.
